posts.text: One man. One tar. One homeland. In honor of Ali Ghamsari — standing at the Damavand Combined Cycle Power Plant, turning music into resistance. For Iran. For its patriots.
posts.why: Explicit patriotic framing: 'One homeland', 'turning music into resistance. For Iran. For its patriots.'

posts.text: IRAN WON! The way to crush imperialism has been shown to the world. Trump Surrendered. TACO will always remain TACO.
posts.why: 'IRAN WON!', 'Trump Surrendered', celebrating Iran crushing imperialism and mocking its adversary.

posts.text: Huge love to everyone who's been standing with us and supporting Iran. We're not stopping — the LEGO-style animations will keep coming, stronger than ever. A lot of you asked how you can support us through Donation, so here it is. These are our Solana, Bitcoin
posts.why: Donation appeal framed around thanking those 'supporting Iran' and promising more pro-Iran content.

posts.text: We will not abandon Lebanon. Wait a little...
posts.why: Endorses Iran's regional commitment with a threatening promise ('We will not abandon Lebanon. Wait a little...').

posts.text: Your blood is our blood. Your children are our children. We will never abandon Lebanon. Wait a little...
posts.why: Solidarity rhetoric ('Your blood is our blood... never abandon Lebanon') endorsing the state's axis-of-resistance position.

posts.text: His blood will carve its own path, And unleash a storm... Path of Blood
posts.why: Martyrdom/vengeance imagery ('His blood will carve its own path, and unleash a storm') glorifies resistance narrative, though target is unnamed.
